analysis: Carolinas RB question (Jonathan Brooks, groin) and Clevelands own RB question (Dylan Sampson, on IR) continue to roughly offset, keeping the spread close to a coinflip on talent alone. Whats new this cycle is a confirmed reverse line move: 94% of handle is on Carolina, yet the spread moved AGAINST them (Panthers -3 down to -1.5 to -2.5 depending on book) -- the market moved toward Cleveland despite the public/money leaning Panthers, which is exactly the pattern this project treats as a real sharp signal rather than noise.

That RLM is a timing signal, not a talent signal on its own, and by this projects own rule it alone cant push confidence above Medium -- but its a real, worth-noting angle on a game that was otherwise a pure coinflip. The total (Over 42.5) remains the more model-driven read, just short of the projects own 60% confidence bar.
